utterances.text: Oh, I see. MR. DI FAZIO: And they have got numbers on them but no other indication.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Because P419 is the larger document, the one which contains them all. In actual fact if you look into your records under P419 what do you find, Mr. Siller? MR. DI FAZIO: I understand they were all -- P419 is part of the one bundle.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: We better be precise on this otherwise it could lead to confusion.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, I got indicated that the Prosecutor would like to tender under P419 number eight, photographs, 18th of July, 2004, of the police station. MR. DI FAZIO: It's 18 photographs I believe.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Yes, 18 photographs, but this was only premarked so they are not yet tendered. MR. DI FAZIO: Well, perhaps after the witness has spoken about them I'll move them from being premarked to being fully exhibits.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. Go ahead. MR. DI FAZIO: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. First one bearing number 03617694, do you recognise that place?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What is it?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: This is the police station, the cellar door from the other side.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Is that the entrance to the SUP?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: Yes -- no. This is the cellar door, the ground floor, from the opposite side.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. Thank you. MR. DI FAZIO: Can the witness be shown the next photograph. This one bears all the same numbers as the previous photograph. And for the sake of expediency I'll just --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] This is the post office building in Srebrenica. MR. DI FAZIO: And for the sake of expediency I'll refer to the photos by the last two numbers, as the numbers are identical in every other sense.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So 96 shows the post office building.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: He said it already. 98. MR. DI FAZIO: Yes, thank you. Can the witness be shown the next number bearing -- ending in 98.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Do you know where -- what that photograph shows?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: I think this is part of the entrance outside the old police station.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Do you remember any blue walls in the SUP building when you were incarcerated there?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. MR. DI FAZIO: Can the witness be shown the next.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Mr. Nikolic --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone for the President, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Nikolic, look carefully at that photo that -- I suppose you can give him the photo that you have, usher, please. Look carefully, what do you see in the upper left-hand part of the photo? What's that? Does it look like a radiator, heating radiator?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, yes, a radiator.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Now, if you look further down but on the right-hand side of the photo, what can you see there?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I think it's some sort of a toilet, a toilet bell, something like that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: So do you stand by your explanation given just a few minutes ago that this could be the entrance of the prison or the police station, or would it be the toilet? Because I don't suppose you --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] This is the entrance to the old police station, as the old police station now abandoned things have been taken off because now there is a new police station and the old one is now abandoned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: But was there a toilet in the entrance of the police station?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] This is from -- a room of some kind, probably. The bathroom or the lavatory, something like that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Let's move, Mr. Di Fazio. MR. DI FAZIO: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now, the photograph I'm showing you now is a slightly different number, 03617700. What does that room show?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: In the room you can see a radiator. You can see a door. This is the entrance to the police station, I think.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. MR. DI FAZIO: Next one, please. This one bears the same number as the previous one except that it ends in 02.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now, do you know what this room is?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: I think this is the room in the prison that we were in. At the bottom to the left was used for the detention of those who would be detained for one, two, or three days in prison where we were. The 16th and the 17th of February, Mico, Kojo, and myself.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: February or January?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: January, my apologies.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. Now, when you were in custody with Kostadin Popovic and Mico Milanovic, was there a bed or there or not?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And look at the window. You see those bars across the window, horizontal bars, were they there or not?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: Yes, yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. MR. DI FAZIO: Next photo, please. This one is numbered 03617704.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Do you recognise this part of this room? And Mr. Nikolic, if you're not sure about a place or what's being shown to you, don't hesitate to say that. Only tell us if you're sure of a location. But have a look at that and tell us is that a -- do you recognise that room?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: I think this is the old police station, but then again, I can't be sure.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. The next one. This one bears number 03617706. What about this place?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: This is also the SUP building, the old one. I think this building is down there near the ...

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes. Usher, please, if -- I would prefer even Judge Eser has suggested it to me and I was actually thinking about it, that maybe if the witness is given the photos that you have in your rather than ask him to look at the monitor -- he is? Thank you. He is being given. Because they are much clearer like this. MR. DI FAZIO: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Have a look at it carefully. Have a look at that photo carefully. Where do you think it was? What do you think it shows?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: I can't remember. It could be the old police station, too.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. Thank you, that's fine. If you can't remember, you can't remember. MR. DI FAZIO: Next one, please. This one bears number 03617708. Can you give us an idea of what this place is.

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: This is the prison between the municipality building and the court. That's where we stayed once we had been transferred from the old police station.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So this is the second location where you were incarcerated?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. MR. DI FAZIO: Next photo. Again, this one bears number 03617710.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Do you recognise that area?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: Yes. This is also the prison where we were held the next time. MR. DI FAZIO: Can we just scroll back to the previous photo.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Look at the previous photo ending in 08 and look at the next photo ending in 10. I think -- I don't think I'm leading you but I think that that shows the same -- on the right-hand side, you can see the same place that was photographed in the previous photo. You can see the bars on the windows, the horizontal bars. Do you see that?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Where was your cell at the second prison? Is it anywhere near that --

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Okay. If you stood up in your cell at the second location and looked out the window, if you did that, is that what you would have seen, that area there? In other words, is the windows up on the right-hand side the window leading to your cell at the municipal building? Or am I wrong?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: Yes. These are our windows, the windows to our cell.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Okay. Go on. MR. DI FAZIO: Next photo, please. This shows 03617712.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: That building with attractive stripes on it, is that the municipal building, the one that's depicted on the right-hand side of the photo?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. Where was your cell? Or --

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: Our cell was between these two buildings where you can see the yellow one down there.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Right at the end of what appears to be a laneway?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: Yes, where you can see yellow up there. And then down there, that's where our prison was.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So you can see a building with what appears to be a yellow or orange addition and underneath at the end of the laneway is a building built in more materials of --

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: Down there is where our prison was, and there's a man who works in the recruitment office who built a house on top because there was just one huge concrete slab without a roof at the time.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. So are you saying that the pink or orange top is an addition to the building that was added after you had been imprisoned?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thanks. Next one, please. Does that show the court and the municipal building?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And that's number 03617714. MR. DI FAZIO: Next photograph, please. 03617716.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Does that also depict the municipal building?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. MR. DI FAZIO: Next photo, please. 03617718.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Do you recognise that corridor?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: Yes. This is a corridor in our prison where we were detained.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. You can see two doors there on the left-hand side of the corridor. Is either one of those your -- the door that led to your cell or is that not so? Or you can't be sure?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: No. Our door was straight down the corridor and these doors, in one of these cells, there were 14 women and four children.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. MR. DI FAZIO: Next one. 03617720.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Do you have any idea where that -- where those doors and stairs are located? Again, if you're not sure -- if you're not sure, say so.

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: I think this is the old police station, the stairs to the first floor.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. MR. DI FAZIO: Next one. Same number as before except ending in 22.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Do you recognise that corridor?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: I think this is the old police station. MR. DI FAZIO: If Your Honours would please bear with me. We've gone past time, but I'll finish this in a minute or two.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes. You've three or four more photos. Finish those and we adjourn. MR. DI FAZIO: Thank you. Next photo, please. 03617724.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What building is that?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: This is the old police station, the entrance.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. MR. DI FAZIO: Next number. Identical to the previous number except ending in 26.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What is that building?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: Police station again.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. MR. DI FAZIO: Next one. And again same number as before, except ending in the number 28.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What is that building?

utterances.speaker: RATKO NIKOLIC
utterances.text: This is the police station again. But the entrance as you approach from the left this is the cellar door to the old police station. MR. DI FAZIO: If Your Honours please, that's the end of the photographs. That just leaves the video which will take about 10 minutes tomorrow. I don't intend to show all of it. And then my examination-in-chief is complete.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. So we stand adjourned until tomorrow morning. Yes. They are tendered as P419 and then 1, 2, whatever. MR. DI FAZIO: For the purposes of the transcript, I ask that it now be given a full exhibit number.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes. P419. Mr. Nikolic, we will continue and finish tomorrow. I thank you. Yes, Mr. Jones.

utterances.speaker: MR. JONES
utterances.text: Your Honours, I know it goes without saying but if the witness could be reminded.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes. Mr. Nikolic, while you are still giving testimony, that means until tomorrow, you are not to communicate with anyone on the matters that you are testifying about, and that doesn't mean just face-to-face, but also on the phone. I don't want you to speak or contact anyone on the matters that you are testifying about. Have I made myself clear?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. We stand adjourned until tomorrow morning. And tomorrow morning we are changing courtroom because of an initial appearance commitment that there is. So instead of -- we will be sitting in courtroom 2, courtroom 2 tomorrow morning at 9.00. Thank you.
